license: Original work generated in Blender from a checked-in script; concept reference from Paul's paid Higgsfield plan (Terms of Use 4.4)

authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The brass hue is unchanged: the front skirt still goes pale gold and the outer ring and back skirt cream under the key lights. The runtime replaces the brass slot with the shared brass-polished set (brass-aged renders paler still), so the fix is a runtime tint or a bronze shared set, outside this generator.
The keyhole core's hot centre stays saturated yellow rather than white-hot. In the EEVEE compare the keyhole reads close to a round disc with a short tail; the shape is clearer in the engine shots.
The pauldrons are still smooth domes with one engraved ring and three rivets, beside the concept's layered pauldrons.
Engraved panel lines and rivets are geometry and read at compare scale, but at play distance they are faint, and the brushed streak texture still looks stretched on the skirt.
Orbit band placement is unchanged: from the side it swings about 0.4 m in front of the chest, where the concept's side view keeps it behind the shoulders.
In the death pose the folded orbit band still intersects the halo rings on the floor.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 24/30, signature features 23/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 12/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from orrery-warden.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's front, side and back angles, framed at the concept's own scale, 2.70 m over the crop height) side by side and in zoomed crops of the chest, core, legs and feet, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now render the warden-glow slot through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close is the seat camera at the 50 degree lens of docs/verification/p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and matched the previous committed still at a mean difference of 1.02/255 before this build. Silhouette: the lower legs are now slim calf lofts under two tapered greave lames with a front ridge, a knee cop and ankle cops, ending in pointed sabatons with three instep lames, a heel cup and a gunmetal sole. The box-palm hands are replaced by lofted gauntlets with a back plate, a knuckle bar, four three-segment fingers with dark joints and a two-segment thumb. The pauldrons are still domes and the orbit band still swings in front of the chest from the side. Signature: the round core disc is replaced by a keyhole (a ring over a tapering slot in a brass frame) with a glow channel running down the abdomen, and the head carries a raised brow plate and gunmetal cheek recesses. Surface: engraved grooves and riveted strips on the pectorals, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves are geometry (the GLB must stay image-free and the brass slot takes the shared set's normal map, so no normal-map bake). They read at compare scale but are subtle at play distance. Colour: the glow keeps the reviewer's measured amber. The brass is unchanged because the slot is replaced at runtime by the shared brass-polished set, so no generator-side lever moves its hue. In the engine glow-close shot the skirt median is (128,100,63) against the concept's (131,93,63): value matches, but the hue is yellower and the highlights go pale.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: Geometry is unchanged since d291e3c and the fidelity compare and review sheet carry the same sha256 as at the 79 review, so the shape findings were re-confirmed on those crops and on the new engine state shots rather than re-derived. Front outline is right: two halo rings, tilted orbit band, long tasset skirt, pointed segmented sabatons, fingered gauntlets. Still off: the greaves are two stacked straight cylinders with a stepped width change, where the concept greave swells at the calf, tapers to the ankle and carries knee cops. The side view is a thin torso column without the concept's chest depth, with a round egg head and dome pauldrons, and the orbit band swings in front of the chest where the concept keeps it behind the shoulders.

All signature parts are present and visible in idle, attack, hit and glow-close: two halo rings, the orbit band with ruby, sapphire and emerald planets, shoulder jewels, the eclipse disc, and the sun core with its lit channel down the abdomen. Unchanged deductions: the core is a large round disc rather than the concept's small keyhole in a ribbed bezel, and the eyes are large round lenses in an egg head rather than narrow slits in an elongated skull mask with a raised brow plate.

Up 2 from 13 for the gunmetal fix, measured on the Warden row of rime-sheet-ice.jpg at full resolution (rime-BRASS042-6-*.jpg, 1280x800). Skirt centre strip box (632,200)-(642,270): old rime (116,116,114) neutral silver, unfrozen now (56,45,43), new ice rime (52,46,55). Waist band box (622,110)-(660,120): old rime (98,90,69), new ice (36,33,31), close to the art bible warm black #231D1A. The strips no longer read as polished steel and are no longer the brightest non-glow value on the lower body. The concept's value order is not fully restored, though: strip luminance 47 against the brass skirt median luminance 46, so plates and joints separate by hue and saturation (brass S 0.44 against strip S 0.09), not by value, where the concept's plates sit clearly lighter than its joints. The ice tint pushes the strip to hue about 280, a violet-grey rather than blue ice, and the brass under rime barely moves ((72,41,28) against unfrozen (74,40,23)), so the frozen state is subtle. ingame-bronze.jpg and ingame-compare-bronze.jpg were captured with the old rime (brass (76,45,26) and strip (116,116,114) match the old-rime frame exactly) and are used only as tint evidence. Unchanged: smooth cuirass and dome pauldrons, swirling streak texture on the skirt, engraved grooves reading as thin dark slits at play distance.

Up 1 from 12. Measured as sRGB with Pillow and NumPy over a warm-metal mask (max channel over 35, R over B plus 12, saturated core glow excluded). Concept whole front body (170,100)-(880,1030): median (104,70,51), hue 22, L 0.30, S 0.34, 90th-percentile highlight (210,169,110). Concept chest plate (440,290)-(480,380) (113,71,46). Concept skirt (410,540)-(480,750) (109,78,56), hue 25, L 0.32, S 0.32. Studio engine idle.jpg upper body (250,40)-(730,480), above the floor: (102,67,44), hue 24, L 0.29, S 0.40, against the previous build's p6 chest (84,53,25), hue 28, L 0.21. Midtone hue and value now match the concept within 2 deg and 0.01 L, which is the main gain. Remaining faults: highlights are cream-pink (238,205,177) against the concept's gold (210,169,110), blue 67 too high, which gives the studio shots a copper-rose cast the concept lacks. The studio skirt (396,360)-(576,554) at (88,55,34), L 0.24, S 0.44 is darker and more saturated than the concept skirt. In the room (new ice frame) the skirt (595,125)-(705,280) is (72,41,28), hue 18, L 0.20, redder and darker than the concept's 22 to 25 deg. The studio core (430,200)-(500,260) 90th percentile (249,215,116) is still saturated yellow against the concept's near-white peak (255,252,198). Gunmetal is now dark (see material). Planets keep correct jewel tones. glow-close.jpg and p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg share sha256 8101d0f1, so they are one shot.

Studio shots (idle, attack, hit, frozen, death) read cleanly: the core is the brightest saturated point and the halo and planets mark the Warden. In the room (rime-BRASS042-6-new.jpg, the frame the player sees in combat) the dark strips now give the skirt and waist readable internal structure instead of silver bands. Faults that persist: the core renders as a dim ochre disc, median (146,116,40), max (148,132,47), identical in the unfrozen frame and below the brass skirt 95th-percentile speculars (184,152,132), so it is not the focal point the art bible asks for. The right skirt edge (680,140)-(700,270) merges with the wainscot behind it (720,190)-(760,260): luminance 44 against 42 and hue 17 against 18, now with no silver strip to break the edge. The left edge separates fine against the corridor floor (luminance 41 against 84). At the seated framing the head and halo are cropped off the top of the frame. Net level with the previous 8.

topFixes: Make the core the in-room focal point: in the room it is a dim ochre disc (146,116,40), below the brass speculars (184,152,132) and far from the concept's near-white peak (255,252,198). Raise the in-room emissive and push the centre toward white-hot, in both the studio and the room.

Fix the brass highlights and in-room hue: speculars are cream-pink (238,205,177) against the concept's gold (210,169,110), and the in-room skirt sits at hue 18 deg against the concept's 22 to 25. Cut blue in the highlight response (or in the tint, whose blue 0.75 sits above green 0.55) so the metal reads golden bronze rather than copper-rose, and lift skirt value slightly so the right edge separates from the wainscot (luminance 44 against 42).

Rebuild the side profile, head and lower legs: chest depth with layered pauldrons, the orbit band behind the shoulders, an elongated skull mask with narrow eye slits and a raised brow plate, a smaller keyhole core in a ribbed bezel, and greaves that swell at the calf and taper to the ankle with knee cops.
independentScore.method: Re-score of build d950e09 (brass tint re-aimed to [0.8,0.55,0.75], tint applied to factor-only slots, freeze rime replaced by a luminance-preserving ice tint; geometry unchanged since d291e3c) with the same five-criterion rubric, re-measuring every claim of the 79 review. Shape was re-checked on the fidelity compare and review sheet (same hashes as at the 79 review, so they are valid shape evidence, but they predate the tint and are not used for colour) and on the new engine state shots. Colour was measured with Pillow and NumPy: medians, HLS hue, lightness and saturation, and 90th or 95th luminance-percentile means over a warm-metal mask, with explicit pixel boxes stated in the notes. Engine numbers use an upper-body box above the floor, because a whole-frame box picks up the brown floor. In-room evidence is the Warden row of rime-sheet-ice.jpg, read at full resolution from rime-BRASS042-6-unfrozen/old/new.jpg; the new ice frame is what the player sees in combat. ingame-bronze.jpg and ingame-compare-bronze.jpg were captured before the rime change (their brass and strip values match the old-rime frame exactly), so they serve only as tint evidence. The art bible palette (polished brass #DEC16A, warm black #231D1A for gunmetal joints, one amber core as focal point) is a secondary check; fidelity is scored against the concept. The rise from 79 comes from the gunmetal strips turning dark (+2 material) and the studio body midtone matching the concept (+1 colour).
